sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B-AWQ-INT4 vs Qwen3.8-27B — comparison, examples, use cases
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.8-27B-AWQ-INT4 is a 27-billion parameter causal language model with integrated vision encoding, maintained by cyankiwi. This is an INT4 quantized variant of Qwen3.8-27B using Activation-Aware Quantization (AWQ), reducing the model to 21.02 GB from its full size while maintaining performance.
